hint: Properties of the device: iOS version, model, serial number, battery, storage, MAC, supervision, Activation Lock. Queries lists the keys to return (unknown keys are skipped). Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Acknowledged, QueryResponses.
Security: passcode present, encryption, compliance with the profiles, management status (supervised, enrolled via ADE). Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Acknowledged.
Certificates installed by profiles, e.g. the device identity of SCEP. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Acknowledged.
Installed profiles: the Identifier is for RemoveProfile, IsManaged=true when MDM installed it. The 'installed' marks of the ready profiles come from it. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Acknowledged.
Provisioning profiles of the apps (ad-hoc / enterprise signing, e.g. WebDriverAgent); the UUID is for RemoveProvisioningProfile. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: empty.
The restrictions in force, merged from all profiles (GlobalRestrictions). Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Acknowledged.
Apps of the user (the system apps are not listed). ManagedAppsOnly=true: the apps installed by MDM only; Identifiers narrows the list. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: empty on an erased device.
Apps installed by MDM (InstallApplication) and their install state. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: empty.
Books / PDFs installed by InstallMedia. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Acknowledged.
Users of a Shared iPad, not on iPhone. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Error 12021 'not a valid request type'.
Restart. NotifyUser is macOS only. The enrollment survives the restart. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Acknowledged, back in about 1.5 minutes.
Shut down. Only the button of the device turns it on again: a visit to the farm. Not checked.
Locks the screen. Message / PhoneNumber are shown only with a passcode. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Acknowledged, MessageResult=NoPasscodeSet.

Removes the passcode with the UnlockToken the device sent at the enrollment, filled in by mcloud-mdm (the UnlockToken tag of the device). It also UNPAIRS the device from every computer (checked on iOS 18.7.11, every time): the host of the device loses USB (go-ios: InvalidHostID) until it pairs again, with no prompt on a supervised device: ios pair --p12file=<supervision.p12>. MDM keeps working.
Clears the Screen Time / restrictions passcode. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Acknowledged.
ERASES the device. Without ADE supervision and MDM are gone afterwards: activate, prepare, Developer Mode and enroll again over USB. Not checked.
Ends 'Await Configuration' of Setup Assistant of an ADE enrollment, no effect otherwise. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Acknowledged, no effect.
Starts AirPlay mirroring to a receiver (DestinationName or DestinationDeviceID) of the same network. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Error 1301 'destination could not be found' with no receiver.
Stops AirPlay mirroring. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Acknowledged.
Refreshes the eSIM plans from the server of the carrier: eSIMServerURL must be its real URL. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: CommandFormatError with an empty URL.

args.Message: This device belongs to the MCloud device farm

hint: Lost Mode: the screen is locked with the message (Message or PhoneNumber is required) until DisableLostMode; DeviceLocation and PlaySound work only in it. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Acknowledged.
Ends Lost Mode, the device shows a notification. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Acknowledged.
The location (latitude, longitude, accuracy), in Lost Mode with Location Services only. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Acknowledged, accuracy about 15 m.
A loud sound, in Lost Mode only. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Acknowledged.
The code that activates an erased device locked by an Apple ID: keep it in the secret store. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: code received.
Removes the bypass code from the device once it is kept. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Acknowledged.
Device name (supervised). Every item of Settings has its own Status in the report. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: renamed at once.
Time zone (an IANA name). Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Acknowledged.
Bluetooth on / off. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: off and on Acknowledged.
Wallpaper from a PNG / JPEG (choose the file below). Where: 1 lock screen, 2 home screen, 3 both. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: home screen changed.
Data roaming, no effect without a SIM. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Acknowledged.
Personal Hotspot, no effect without a SIM. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Acknowledged.

How updates are offered: 0 all, 1 the older branch only, 2 the newest only. To hide updates on iOS 18 use the ready profile 'Hide iOS updates for 90 days' (the DDM deferral did not hide them). Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Acknowledged.
The organization name shown in Settings and the MDM dialogs. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Acknowledged.
Installs a .mobileconfig (choose the file below) with no prompt on the device; RemoveProfile removes what MDM installed. See also the ready profiles. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: a web clip installed.

Removes a profile installed by MDM by its Identifier of ProfileList. Never the MDM profile itself: the device leaves MDM (enroll it again with the agent of its host). Checked on iOS 18.7.11: the web clip removed.
Installs a .mobileprovision (choose the file), e.g. to renew the signing of WebDriverAgent without a reinstall. Not checked.
Removes a provisioning profile by its UUID of ProvisioningProfileList. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Acknowledged even for an unknown UUID.

Installs an app: ManifestURL of an https manifest of an ipa (ad-hoc / enterprise) or iTunesStoreID (needs a VPP license). ManagementFlags=1 removes the app with MDM. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Error 2604 'Could not validate manifest' with no URL.
Removes an app installed by MDM by its bundle ID (not the apps of the user). Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Error 12038 'not managed'.
Validates the signing of the enterprise / ad-hoc apps, e.g. after a renewed provisioning profile. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Acknowledged.
The Managed App Configuration of the managed apps. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: empty.
The attributes of the managed apps (VPN UUID, domains, ...). Checked on iOS 18.7.11: empty.
The feedback the managed apps write for MDM. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: empty.
An App Store redemption code of an app waiting for one (old VPP flow). Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Error 2611 'Not waiting for redemption code'.
Invitation to the VPP program of Apple Business: a real InvitationURL is needed. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Error 12008.
Installs a book / PDF into Books from its URL. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Acknowledged, State=Installing.
Removes a book by its PersistentID. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Acknowledged.
The updates of the device: name, Build, ProductKey (for ScheduleOSUpdate). Lists the deferred updates too. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: iOS 18.7.12 available.
The download and install progress of an update. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Idle.
May UPDATE iOS. InstallAction: DownloadOnly, InstallASAP, NotifyOnly, InstallLater, Default; ProductKey of AvailableOSUpdates. Use the DDM softwareupdate.enforcement.specific on iOS 26+. Not checked.
Makes the device synchronize its DDM declarations (as 'DDM: synchronize' of the API tab). Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Acknowledged.
Logs the user of a Shared iPad out. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Error 12021 on iPhone.
Deletes a user of a Shared iPad. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Error 12021 on iPhone.
Ends the setup of a user (Shared iPad). Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Error 12021 on iPhone.
Enhanced log collection, iOS 27+. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Error 12021.
Cancels the log collection, iOS 27+. Checked on iOS 18.7.11: Error 12021.
